pages.text: Plain molasses is the base for every flavored shisha bottle. It is made through the Brewing Stand rather than the crafting table.

Put a $(item)Potion bottle$() into a Brewing Stand and use $(item)Sugar Cane$() as the brewing ingredient. A plain Water Bottle works because it is the vanilla Potion item with water contents. The result is a Bottle of Molasses.
pages.title: Brewing Plain Molasses

pages.text: Most flavors are then simple shapeless crafting: $(thing)1 Bottle of Molasses + the listed food/ingredient$() → 1 flavored molasses bottle. Flavor bottles have $(item)4 uses$() when mixed into shisha.
pages.title: Flavoring
